primarySourcesInspected.title: Общие сведения о русском письме (General information on Russian writing)
primarySourcesInspected.locator: Section “Русский алфавит” / paragraph beginning “Русский алфавит (набор букв…)”: states 33 letters, uppercase and lowercase variants, alphabet sequence and names; indexed page text includes the full sequence. It does not give all individual IPA values or Spanish equivalents.
primarySourcesInspected.finding: Partial or insufficient for the full claim.

primarySourcesInspected.title: Русский алфавит (Russian alphabet)
primarySourcesInspected.locator: Section “Русский алфавит (в скобках указаны названия букв)”: alphabet entries with Cyrillic forms and letter names, including names for Х, Ц, Ч, Ш, Щ, Ъ, Ы, Ь, Э, Ю, Я; discusses names as nouns. Supports grapheme/name only.
primarySourcesInspected.finding: Partial or insufficient for the full claim.

primarySourcesInspected.title: Основной принцип употребления букв (Basic principle of letter use)
primarySourcesInspected.locator: Section “Основной принцип употребления букв”: ten vowel letters in five pairs; ь marks softness of paired consonants in specified positions; е/ё/ю/я may signal a preceding palatalized consonant or [j]+vowel depending on position. Does not endorse unqualified “all adjacent vowels soften” rules.
primarySourcesInspected.finding: Partial or insufficient for the full claim.

primarySourcesInspected.title: Буквы ъ и ь (Letters ъ and ь)
primarySourcesInspected.locator: Section “Буквы ъ и ь” and subsection “Буква ь как знак мягкости согласного”: ь can mark softness of a paired consonant at word end/before consonant; ъ has a separating function before iotated vowels and indicates [j]+vowel rather than softening the preceding consonant.
primarySourcesInspected.finding: Partial or insufficient for the full claim.

primarySourcesInspected.title: Russian: Illustrations of the IPA
primarySourcesInspected.locator: “Consonants” and “Vowels” sections, pp. 222–224; phoneme chart and transcribed passage/audio on pp. 221–228. Describes standard Russian consonant and vowel realizations, palatalization contrast, context-dependent vowel reduction and IPA examples. It does not support pedagogical comparisons with Spanish or all article-specific unstated recommendations.
primarySourcesInspected.finding: Partial or insufficient for the full claim.

primarySourcesInspected.title: Современное русское письмо. Пособие для учителей (Modern Russian writing: guide for teachers)
primarySourcesInspected.locator: Chapter/section on printed and handwritten Russian letter forms; scanned teaching guide discusses differences between print and handwritten/cursive forms. The current article’s claims about each particular glyph and learning advice were not checked against a page-specific plate.
primarySourcesInspected.finding: Partial or insufficient for the full claim.
